title: Fino Payments Bank Sees Growth in Deposits and Loan Referrals
summary: Fino Payments Bank reported an 11% year-on-year growth in deposits to ₹2,755 crore, with a significant increase in loan referrals. However, the bank's transaction throughput declined 35% due to the shift to UPI. The growth in deposits and loan referrals suggests a positive trend for the bank.
summary_points: Fino Payments Bank reported an 11% year-on-year growth in deposits to ₹2,755 crore
The bank saw a significant increase in loan referrals, with a 3.5x rise in transaction value
Transaction throughput declined 35% due to the shift to UPI
The growth in deposits and loan referrals suggests a positive trend for the bank
The decline in transaction throughput may be attributed to the shift to UPI
title_hi: फिनो पेमेंट्स बैंक की जमा और लोन रेफरल में वृद्धि
summary_hi: फिनो पेमेंट्स बैंक ने ₹2,755 करोड़ तक पहुंची अपनी वर्ष-वार जमा वृद्धि, साथ ही लोन रेफरल में भी महत्वपूर्ण वृद्धि देखी। हालांकि, बैंक की ट्रांजैक्शन थ्रूगुट डाउन 35% तक गिर गई, जो UPI पर शिफ्ट करने से जुड़ी है। जमा और लोन रेफरल में वृद्धि के साथ-साथ बैंक की ओर एक सकारात्मक दिशा दिखाई देती है।
